text:
devon: Hey team — trying to get the ruby sampleapp running on my M1 Mac and `bundle install` fails on msgpack native extension.

Console paste:

devon: ```
Building native extensions. This could take a while...
ERROR: Failed to build gem native extension.
...
make: *** [obj/msgpack.o] Error 1
``` 

devon: Ruby 3.2.2 via rbenv, macOS Ventura, Xcode CLT installed. Works fine on my Intel CI run.

devon: Anyone seen this? minimal support plz, just trying local dev.

aj: have you tried `bundle config build.msgpack --use-system-libraries` and installing msgpack via brew?

aj: run `brew install msgpack` then `bundle install` — on arm64 sometimes gem picks wrong flags.

devon: tried that, brew says msgpack 3.0.0 already. Still fails with same compile error.

aj: can you paste `gem env` and full `bundle install` output? also, try `arch -arm64 gem install msgpack -v '1.5.2'` to force arch.

devon: pasted `gem env` (short):

devon: ```
RubyGems Environment:
  - RUBYGEMS VERSION: 3.4.27
  - RUBY VERSION: 3.2.2 (2024-05-10 patchlevel 0) [arm64-darwin22]
  - INSTALLATION DIRECTORY: /Users/devon/.rbenv/versions/3.2.2/lib/ruby/gems/3.2.0
``` 

devon: Installing gem with `arch -arm64 gem install msgpack -v '1.5.2'` gives same make error.

sam: fyi we added a note in the README for Windows earlier; maybe we need an M1 note too.

sam: quick hack: you can add `gem 'msgpack', platforms: [:ruby]` or pin to the pure ruby fallback if available.

aj: second thought — msgpack >= 1.5 has native C ext; check if `gem install msgpack -- --with-cflags="-O2"` helps. also ensure `clang` path from Xcode is available: `xcode-select --install`.

devon: `xcode-select` is fine. tried `gem install msgpack -- --with-cflags="-O2 -mmacosx-version-min=11.0"` — still fails.

katie: do we run macOS arm64 in our sampleapp CI matrix? I remember CI only covers intel macos-latest.

sam: no, CI is intel only atm. that's why we didn't catch this. we should update matrix or add a note.

devon: I made a tiny branch with README note + fallback in Gemfile: `1977654321-ruby-m1-readme-fix` — created PR #342. requesting review.

katie: will review. also can we add a GH Actions job to repro? quick `runs-on: macos-12` with `strategy.matrix.arch: [x64, arm64]` should surface it.

ci-bot: PR #342: CI triggered — macos-intel: passed, linux: passed, macos-arm64: failed (bundle install step)

katie: thanks @devon — approve the README change, leave Gemfile fallback for now. Sam can follow up to decide if we bundle a prebuilt gem or adjust CI.

devon: thanks all. will update the PR with the CI note and link to this thread.

devon: small win: local workaround was `rbenv uninstall 3.2.2 && rbenv install 3.2.2` then `bundle install`. reinstalled ruby rebuilt things and `bundle install` succeeded — weird but worked.

aj: that sometimes fixes mismatched arch compile flags if the ruby was installed under different Rosetta mode.

devon: documented the reinstall workaround in the PR. :thumbsup:
